word_translation_en: to start; to begin; to launch
sentence_example: Wir starten das neue Projekt am Montag.
sentence_example_translation_en: We are starting the new project on Monday.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Мы начинаем новый проект в понедельник.
sentence_synonym: Wir beginnen das neue Projekt am Montag.
typical_collocations: ein Projekt starten; einen Versuch starten; eine Kampagne starten; den Motor starten
usage_comments_en: The verb 'starten' can be transitive (meaning to launch or activate something) or intransitive (to begin a journey or activity, or to take off). While often interchangeable with 'beginnen' or 'anfangen', 'starten' sounds more dynamic and is heavily used in sports, technology, and business contexts.

word_translation_en: to take off; to launch full-force; to go around (aviation)
word_translation_ru: уйти на второй круг (авиа); совершить прорыв; резко пойти в гору
sentence_example: Nach der Pause will sie in ihrer Karriere wieder voll durchstarten.
sentence_example_translation_en: After the break, she wants to kick-start her career again with full energy.
sentence_example_translation_ru: После перерыва она хочет снова мощно рвануть в карьере.
sentence_synonym: Nach der Pause will sie in ihrer Karriere wieder voll loslegen.
typical_collocations: beruflich durchstarten; voll durchstarten; das Flugzeug muss durchstarten
usage_comments_en: Separable verb. In aviation, it means to abort a landing and climb again. Colloquially, it means to advance rapidly with high enthusiasm and energy.
